questions.q: In which year did Mister Fantastic debut in Fantastic Four #1?
questions.why: Reed Richards first appeared in Fantastic Four #1, cover-dated November 1961, kicking off the Marvel Age of comics.

questions.q: In the comics, what gave Reed Richards his stretching powers?
questions.why: An unauthorized rocket flight was bombarded by cosmic radiation, giving Reed his elastic body.
Reed married Sue Storm, the Invisible Woman, in Fantastic Four Annual #3 in 1965.

questions.q: Which villain was Reed's college roommate and intellectual rival?
questions.why: Victor von Doom roomed with Reed at State University and has been his archenemy ever since.

questions.q: Who played Mister Fantastic in the 2005 Fantastic Four film?
questions.why: Ioan Gruffudd played Reed Richards in 2005 and its 2007 sequel Rise of the Silver Surfer.

questions.q: Which actor played a Reed Richards variant in the 2022 Strange sequel Multiverse of Madness?
questions.why: John Krasinski appeared as a Reed variant in that film, a cameo as part of the Illuminati.

questions.q: In which issue did Reed marry Sue in the comics?
questions.why: Their wedding took place in Fantastic Four Annual #3 in July 1965, a big event for readers.

questions.q: What is the name of Reed and Sue's daughter?
questions.why: Valeria Richards, a child genius, is the younger sibling of Franklin Richards.

questions.q: Reed Richards is a member of which secret council of Marvel heroes?
questions.why: Reed is a core member of the Illuminati, the covert group that makes decisions about threats to Earth.

questions.q: Which fictional school did Reed Richards and Ben Grimm attend?
questions.why: Reed and Ben met at the fictional Empire State University, where Ben had a football scholarship.
